name: target-acquisition
intent: Pick a training target; SCAN snaps four angular brackets inward on a frozen stagger ladder and fills confidence in four discrete steps to LOCKED.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Brackets and confidence meter appear immediately at 92% with LOCKED label

acceptance: Three training targets; pick one then SCAN
Brackets snap inward on frozen stagger ladder: 0/80/160/240ms per corner
Confidence fills in four discrete steps: 24% → 48% → 72% → 92%
LOCKED label visible at end state; SCAN disabled
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) shows locked state immediately
No network; polite aria-live on status
waveB: Title aligned to catalogue; bracket/confidence ladders frozen via CSS vars
